units.source_text: 早在四年前的一个晚上，我在澡堂里冷不防地遭到一股浓香的侵袭。

en.t: As early as one evening four years ago, I was suddenly assailed in the bathhouse by a strong fragrance.

units.source_text: 我不知道这香水的名称，但赤着身子嗅到这种馥郁的香味，感到非常羞愧。

en.t: I did not know the name of that perfume, but smelling such a rich scent while naked made me feel terribly ashamed.

units.source_text: 嗅着嗅着，我一阵目眩神迷。

en.t: As I kept breathing it in, I was overcome for a moment by dizziness and rapture.

units.source_text: 这时辰，正好是你抛弃我，瞒着我去结婚的时刻；

en.t: That very hour was exactly the time when you abandoned me and went off to marry without telling me;

units.source_text: 这时辰，你正在新婚旅行的途中，第一个晚上在旅馆里洁白的床上，洒上了新娘子的香水。

en.t: At that hour, you were on your honeymoon journey, sprinkling the bride's perfume on the white bed in an inn on your first night.

units.source_text: 我不知道你结婚，我是在后来联想起来的。

en.t: I did not know you had married; only later did I put it together.

units.source_text: 这两件事简直是在同一时辰发生的。

en.t: Those two things happened at virtually the very same hour.
